name: Data.heightLe_inv_heckeValueProd_div
summary: The Hecke value product is a product of L-value ratios of rank-one pairs (each of height ≤ 6B₀ − 𝖴 by heightLe_inv_ratio) and of ramified pairs (height ≤ x^999 by the fit family), up to a power of N(Q).

steps.claim: The product over the points z ∈ (7⌊m/2⌋, heckeCount] of the inverse ratios of the lower points of the pair at 'none' (rank one: heightLe_inv_ratio) times the product over the signs s and z ∈ (0, e_s] of the inverse ratios of the ramified pairs (the fit family's bound hf.3, ω^{(…)} ≠ 1) has the sum of the heights; squared (power 2), and the bound is compared through heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul.
steps.lean:
((θ ι).powTwist j) / heckeValueProd j 1)⁻¹ := hf.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul (((HeightLe.prod (s :=
  Ioc (7 * (D.m / 2)) D.heckeCount) fun z _ ↦ heightLe_inv_ratio hf j ((linePair j none).lowerPoint
  z) (by simp [IsRankOne, HasLiftRank, Pair.lowerPoint, linePair]; grind [heckeCount, le_m])).mul
  (.prod (s := univ.sigma (Ioc 0 <| Option.elim · (7 * (D.m / 2)) D.eSign)) fun x _ ↦
  hf.3 j ((linePair j x.1).lowerPoint x.2) (x.1.getD 1)
  (by cases x.1 <;> exact omega_zpow_ne_one _ (by simp [Int.natAbs_mul]; grind)))).pow

steps.claim: The bound: (heckeCount − 7⌊m/2⌋) rank-one pairs give at most k(6B₀ − 𝖴) and the ramified pairs at most 10m·x^999 (m and k even).
steps.lean: 2) (by simp [eSign, heckeCount, Even.two_dvd, m_even, k_even]; grind)

steps.claim: For each ι with nonzero value: the inverse Hecke value quotient equals N(Q)^{−Σ_i z_i²} times the product of the squared inverse ratios (lValueProd_eq at the twist, splitting the intervals of points: prod_Ioc_consecutive), using step 3.1; then field arithmetic.
steps.lean:
fun ι n ↦
  ⟨-∑ i, (linePair j i).z ^ 2, by
  simp [heckeValueProd,
    twist_one_spec, ↓lValueProd_eq _ _ ((θ ι).powTwist j).1, ↓_root_.zpow_neg, ↓zpow_natCast,
    Finset.prod_sigma, prod_pow, heckeCount, ← prod_Ioc_consecutive _ zero_le le_self_add, show ∀ s,
    Icc 1 (linePair j s).z = Ioc 0 (s.elim D.heckeCount D.eSign) by rintro ⟨⟩ <;> rfl] at n ⊢
  simp [*, field]; ring!⟩

steps.claim: For every s: the points 1 ≤ z ≤ z_s of the pair at s form the interval (0, heckeCount] at 'none' and (0, e_s] at a sign (by cases; rfl).
steps.lean:
show ∀ s,
    Icc 1 (linePair j s).z = Ioc 0 (s.elim D.heckeCount D.eSign) by rintro ⟨⟩ <;> rfl] at n ⊢
  simp [*, field]; ring!⟩
